settings.title: Best Orthodontist in Dubai for Braces and Clear Aligners

settings.editor: Straighter teeth and a healthier bite, planned by a specialist orthodontist. We treat children, teens and adults with metal, ceramic, lingual and Damon braces, Invisalign and Invisalign First, all in one clinic in Al Satwa, close to Jumeirah.

image.alt: Dr. Jeffrey Manuel, Specialist Orthodontist and Medical Director at Smile On Dental Clinic, Dubai

settings.editor:
Dr. Jeffrey Manuel
Specialist Orthodontist & Medical Director. Certified Invisalign provider, in UAE practice since 2008.
Orthodontics at Smile On

settings.title: Orthodontist in Dubai for Braces and Clear Aligners

settings.editor:
Choosing the right orthodontist is an important decision, especially when treatment affects both your appearance and long-term oral health. At Smile On Dental Clinic, we provide orthodontic care that is precise, well-planned and focused on patient comfort.

Our orthodontic team works with adults, teenagers and children who want straighter teeth, better bite alignment and long-lasting results. Every treatment is planned carefully, using modern techniques and clear communication, so you always know what to expect.

We offer a full range of options to suit every case and lifestyle, including traditional metal and ceramic braces, fully hidden lingual braces and comfortable self-ligating Damon braces. For a removable option there's Invisalign, and Invisalign First for younger patients. Every course of treatment finishes with custom teeth retainers to protect your results.

Many patients looking for an orthodontist near Jumeirah choose our clinic for its experienced team, modern options and clear, patient-focused approach. We're on 2nd December Street in Al Satwa, a practical choice for families, professionals and expats across central Dubai.
Leave your details and our team will call you within 24 hours. Prefer to talk now? Call +971 55 896 1826.
The basics

Orthodontic treatment corrects the position of teeth and jaws. When teeth are crowded, unevenly spaced or the bite doesn't line up, it can affect chewing, speech, oral hygiene and confidence. Braces or clear aligners move teeth gently into healthier positions over time, with a plan tailored to your age, bone structure and dental condition.

settings.title_text: Jaw discomfort related to bite issues
Difficulty cleaning teeth due to misalignment
Concerns about how your smile looks

settings.editor: Orthodontic care isn't just for teenagers. Many adults in Dubai now choose treatment for both functional and aesthetic reasons.

settings.text: Not sure if you need braces? Call us

settings.editor: Treatment options
A full range of options, so your treatment can match your lifestyle, budget and clinical needs.
Swipe to see all options →

settings.description_text: Metal braces are durable and effective for every level of correction. Ceramic braces work the same way but blend with your tooth colour, so they're less noticeable.
Placed behind the teeth, so they're hidden from view. Ideal if you want effective treatment without visible braces.
A self-ligating system that allows smoother tooth movement. Often fewer adjustments and more comfort during treatment.
Custom-made clear aligners that are removable and comfortable. Eat normally and keep up your oral hygiene easily.
Designed for younger patients. Helps guide jaw development while correcting early alignment issues in growing children.
Custom retainers keep your teeth in their new position, with clear guidance on how to wear and care for them.

settings.editor: Compare

settings.title: Braces or Aligners? Your Options at a Glance

settings.editor: Your orthodontist will recommend the best option for your teeth and bite. This quick comparison helps you prepare questions for your consultation.

OptionHow visible?Removable?Good to know
Metal bracesVisibleNoDurable and effective for every level of correction

Want a deeper comparison? Read our guide: Invisalign vs Braces in Dubai.

image.alt: Dr. Jeffrey Manuel, specialist orthodontist at Smile On Dental Clinic, Dubai

settings.editor: Meet your orthodontist

Specialist Orthodontist & Medical Director. Dr. Jeffrey co-founded Smile On Dental Clinic in 2021 and has practised in the UAE since 2008. He treats children, teens and adults, and plans every case personally, from early treatment for growing children to discreet options for working professionals.
Your treatment journey
Orthodontic treatment is a structured process designed to deliver safe, predictable results.

settings.description_text: A detailed assessment, including digital scans, X-rays if needed and a bite analysis.
We explain the recommended option, the estimated duration and how to care for your teeth.
Braces or aligners are adjusted periodically to guide your teeth gradually into place.
Retainers are fitted once alignment goals are reached, to protect your results long term.

FAQ

tabs.tab_title: How long does orthodontic treatment usually take?
tabs.tab_content: It depends on how complex the problem is rather than the type of braces, along with factors such as bone density and age. Treatment usually takes 18 to 24 months. Teenagers often see faster results because much of their growth happens at this stage.

Treatment shouldn't be painful. Most people feel some pressure or soreness for a few days after braces are fitted or adjusted, or when they start a new set of aligners. This usually settles quickly, and soft foods help in the meantime. Your orthodontist will explain what to expect and how to stay comfortable.

tabs.tab_title: Can adults get braces or Invisalign?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Orthodontic care isn't limited to teenagers, and many adults in Dubai choose treatment for both functional and aesthetic reasons. Discreet options such as Invisalign, ceramic braces and lingual braces are popular with working professionals.

tabs.tab_title: Which type of braces is right for me?
tabs.tab_content: Each option works differently. Traditional braces use brackets and wires, Invisalign uses removable clear trays to move teeth into position, and lingual braces are attached behind the teeth. The right choice depends on how severe the problem is, along with cost, treatment time and how discreet you'd like it to be. Our orthodontist will talk you through the options at your consultation.

tabs.tab_title: When should my child see an orthodontist?
tabs.tab_content: An early check helps spot bite and jaw problems while your child is still growing. If treatment is needed, options such as Invisalign First and Myobrace can guide jaw development and correct early alignment issues.

tabs.tab_title: How much do braces cost in Dubai?
tabs.tab_content: The cost depends on the type of braces or aligners, how complex the correction is, how long treatment takes, your age and your retention needs. You'll get a transparent plan with clear cost guidance at your consultation. Call +971 55 896 1826 to book.

tabs.tab_title: What is the difference between an orthodontist and a general dentist for braces?
tabs.tab_content: An orthodontist is a dentist who has completed additional training focused on tooth alignment and bite correction. For braces and complex orthodontic treatment, seeing an orthodontist means a specialist handles your treatment planning and care.
